page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance provisioned on the KVM hypervisor. The virtual machine is powered by the x86_64 architecture using a dedicated Hygon 7447v processor operating at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. The configuration supplies 16 dedicated virtual CPUs coupled with 32.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory allocation of 2.0 GB per core.

The instance does not include integrated local storage or hardware accelerators, leaving disk operations entirely dependent on attached remote block storage solutions. Baseline network throughput is configured at 7 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

By delivering dedicated compute cores at a strict 1:2 memory ratio without the cost overhead of local disks or GPUs, the ecs.c9h.4xlarge offers focused compute resource density. This hardware configuration is suited for compute-intensive workloads that require dedicated execution threads without requiring high memory footprints, including web serving, batch processing, application backends, and distributed compilation tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance based on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. Driven by a dedicated Hygon 7447v processor running at 2.6 GHz, it delivers 16 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a compute-centric ratio of 2.0 GB of memory per core. The instance includes 7 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, contains no bundled local storage, and features zero GPUs. Because storage must be provided via network-attached volumes, the resource footprint is tightly focused on raw CPU execution and deterministic compute performance. The lack of integrated local disks or specialized accelerators yields a focused architecture for scalable, CPU-bound workloads. Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.4xlarge is well aligned with workloads such as frontend web servers, backend application handling, continuous integration runners, and general compute-heavy batch processing jobs.
